### Patience Is a Virtue
Author: Crosswalk.com
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/one-year-devotions-for-men/patience-is-a-virtue-one-year-devotions-for-men-october-5.html
Passage: Numbers 14:17-19
Points:
- People often prefer immediate control and quick fixes, but God values patient endurance in difficult circumstances.
- God demonstrated unmatched patience in sparing rebellious Israel, extending mercy while still upholding His righteousness.
- The Lord continues to show patience in the face of human provocation today, granting people time to repent.
- Believers should mirror God's patience by bearing with less-than-ideal circumstances as He works out His divine plans.
